Check your chain at home

Between visits, a chain checker tells you when a chain is worn. Here is the rule we use, written as code:

// Chain wear, measured with a checker gauge.
function chainAdvice(wearPercent) {
  if (wearPercent >= 0.75) {
    return 'Replace the chain, and check the cassette.';
  }
  if (wearPercent >= 0.5) {
    return 'Replace the chain soon.';
  }
  return 'The chain is fine.';
}...
Between visits, a chain checker tells you when a chain is worn. Here is the rule we use, written as code:

// Chain wear, measured with a checker gauge.
function chainAdvice(wearPercent) {
  if (wearPercent >= 0.75) {
    return 'Replace the chain, and check the cassette.';
  }
  if (wearPercent >= 0.5) {
    return 'Replace the chain soon.';
  }
  return 'The chain is fine.';
}

  2. Drop the checker into the chain.

Quillfern Cycle Works

Services and prices

Prices are fixed for labour. Parts are extra, and we tell you the part price before we fit anything. All prices are invented for this sample site.

Tune-up levels

Wheels and cargo bikes

Wheel truing

A wobbly wheel trued on the stand, with spoke tension evened out.

  • Up to 3 spokes replaced
  • Same-day for most wheels

Hand-built wheels

Built to your rims and hubs, tensioned and stress-relieved.

  • Ready in five working days
  • Free re-true after a month

Cargo bike care

Longtails and front-loaders on our long stand, including steering and child-seat checks.

  • Booked slots only
  • Collection by arrangement

Check your chain at home

Between visits, a chain checker tells you when a chain is worn. Here is the rule we use, written as code:

// Chain wear, measured with a checker gauge.
function chainAdvice(wearPercent) {
  if (wearPercent >= 0.75) {
    return 'Replace the chain, and check the cassette.';
  }
  if (wearPercent >= 0.5) {
    return 'Replace the chain soon.';
  }
  return 'The chain is fine.';
}
  1. Shift to the smallest rear cog.
  2. Drop the checker into the chain.
  3. Read the gauge, then run the rule above.
